ledger.paper_text: Ridge prior centered at current Bt; regularized bias; reused Cholesky; exactly two steps; lambda10
ledger.evidence_value: D=C-Bt gives exactly the objective in Eq.6; lambda I includes augmented bias. Factor formed before loop; loop steps (1,2).

ledger.paper_text: In exact arithmetic with nonzero predictions, T(cB)=cT(B), c>0
ledger.evidence_value: c>0 gives r(cz)=cr(z), u(cz)=u(z); fixed linear ridge operator scales delta; induction scales Bt; normalized inference equal.
ledger.details: Existing analytical qualification is sufficient. Executed code rejects norms <=1e-12 and nonfinite rows, rather than clamping denominator. Positive rescaling can cross guard/finite limits. Float32 stored coefficients/application introduce rounding. No execution-wide or bitwise scaling invariance verified or claimed.
Parameter bytes assume float32 for both, exclude fitting objects/galleries/encoders. Not end-to-end cost.

ledger.paper_text: Fixed summed-objective lambda10 does not isolate data quantity at fixed effective penalty
ledger.details: Dividing sum loss by m gives penalty lambda/m. Effective penalty drops ~28.14x as pairs increase; manuscript explicitly acknowledges this.
